source.verification: Exact candidate tree digest, including uncommitted Clarin .8 source changes; localCommit identifies the base checkout, not a new release commit.

audit.scope: Production npm closure refreshed for local Clarin .8 changes. No dependency version upgrade and no new exhaustive OSV/GitHub scan.

advisories.detail: Inherited advisory remains unresolved. The exact installed closure reaches braces 3.0.3 through Sass/Chokidar. The whiteboard fork build imports sassPlugin (build-excalidraw-fork.mjs); no browser source import or module for braces/chokidar/sass was found in 156 emitted Next webpack development chunks. This supports build-tool reachability for this whiteboard artifact, not a whole-application or production-bundle guarantee. The advisory requires attacker-controlled deeply nested brace patterns reaching the braces parser and can exhaust the Node stack. No such input path was demonstrated in the whiteboard flows tested; exploitability is not dismissed.

Inherited KaTeX 0.16.47 advisory remains unresolved and browser reachability is confirmed: member and guest hosts enable mermaidEnabled independently of aiEnabled=false; mermaid.ts dynamically imports mermaid-to-excalidraw and actual Next webpack browser chunks include Mermaid and KaTeX modules. Mermaid clipboard/diagram input can therefore reach the local rendering chain. The official advisory requires pre-existing Object.prototype pollution or attacker-controlled option prototypes, plus attacker-controlled math; KaTeX itself does not create the pollution. Trust defaults alone do not establish safety under that precondition, and sanitizer bypass/exploitability was not tested. No AI-service or external-network access is implied.

releaseDecision.scope: Clarin .8 semantic stroke presets, export ink bounds and isolated same-origin font workers; upstream unchanged at v0.18.1
releaseDecision.reason: Verification completed in the isolated VPS QA checkout and its production standalone build. This is evidence for review, not deployment authorization. Inherited braces and browser-reachable KaTeX advisories remain in_triage. Large-scene measurements preserve all elements but show substantial interaction and main-thread cost at 50,000 elements; they do not establish fluid editing or production/server performance.

Local-font export test targets Firefox; separately passed there.

Failed image upload then explicit retry without duplicate scene references.

Same-origin URL, no file URL or main-thread fallback, embedded SVG font.
Worker-specific WASM CSP; document policy unchanged; v4 worker copy and v4/v5 manifest SHA match.

memberNavigation.scope: Save-before-Back including a later edit; cancel failed Back and Forward without changing the cursor or same-document history length. Firefox reload baseline is measured separately because the browser adds its own history entry before bootstrap.

runtimeEgress.limitation: Explicit user-triggered fixture link is allow-listed; mocked transport and navigation/teardown chunk aborts are recorded.

fullEditorProfile.scope: Real guest editor, Chromium 145, 1440x900; simple unfilled rectangles with viewport culling. Select one existing element and move it 1px, retain exactly 1k/10k/50k objects and export them. Mock HTTP/WS echoes the full canonical scene in ACK. Includes debounce/browser work; no server/DB latency or FPS claim.

classification.sassChokidarBraces: Installed build-tool chain: fork/Next -> Sass1.51.0 -> Chokidar3.6.0 -> braces3.0.3. The fork build script imports sassPlugin; no direct runtime import or mapped fork source for these tools was found. This is a scoped build-tool classification, not proof of global browser absence from minified Next without production source maps. Advisory stays in_triage.
classification.katexMermaid: Browser runtime confirmed in final minified Next chunks listed above. Both editor hosts set aiEnabled=false but leave mermaidEnabled enabled; local Mermaid parsing reaches KaTeX. Prototype-pollution/attacker-controlled-options preconditions and sanitizer bypass were not exercised; advisory stays in_triage.

artifactReachability.limitations: No exploit remediation or production deployment claim. Static role classification and observed runtime chunks complement, not replace, browser isolation tests.
